kind.value: Marketing calendar with social publishing, ReQueue evergreen automation, analytics, an inbox and project coordination

pricingModel.value: Base tiers include seats and profiles; additional profiles $5/month and a third Professional seat $29/month

freeOption.value: 1 profile and 15 scheduled messages at a time, including drafts and failed unsent messages

trial.value: 14-day Starter/Professional trial, payment card required; automatically charges unless canceled. Suite starts with a demo

entryPaid.value: Starter $39/month billed monthly; $29/month billed annually; 1 seat and 3 profiles

plans.value: Starter $39 and Professional $59/month on monthly billing ($29/$49 annual monthly equivalents). Professional includes 2 seats and 5 profiles, maximum 3 users. Suite is custom, advertised from $69/month

networks.value: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business Profile, YouTube and X
networks.note: Official pages conflict on X billing: pricing says included; plan support still says separate paid add-on. Confirm the applicable quote before budgeting X.

api.value: No public API, explicitly stated in support. Alternatives include Suite-dependent webhooks, Zapier and an ICS calendar feed

mcp.value: Official read-only MCP for Claude and ChatGPT, available on Free, Starter, Professional and Suite
mcp.note: Reads permitted calendars, tasks and social results; cannot create, move, complete or delete items.

teams.value: Starter is solo. Professional adds social approvals, user roles and read-only client calendars; Suite adds task approvals, guest access, custom permissions and SSO
